evals.prompt: On the Draw Answer slide type, in the editor right panel > Content tab, there is an empty vertical gap under the "Collect audience info" section when no additional fields are selected. The Idea Board slide type does not have this gap. Remove the empty space, using Idea Board as the reference.
evals.expected_output: Applies the general rule that every settings object must render at its real height and any empty container must be removed (SETTINGS-19). Runs a differential diagnosis against a native slide type (Idea Board) and accounts for the FULL measured gap (~80px), not just the first cause, identifying BOTH stacked empty containers: (1) the shared empty 'selected-fields' wrapper inside 'display-fields' (flex flex-col gap-4) — 0px tall but forces the parent's 16px flex gap; present on Idea Board too, so fixed in the shared component SlideParticipantFields.vue with v-if selectedParticipantFields.length>0; and (2) the Draw-Answer-specific plugin settings iframe (SlidePluginSetting -> SlidePluginIframeConfig) reporting height:48px with an empty body, +16px .form-group margin ~= 64px, which Idea Board never mounts — fixed in the plugin (report 0 / don't mount when empty) or via host iframe-collapse, NEVER by editing a shared component (SETTINGS-16/17/18). Does NOT stop after fixing only the 16px. Verifies empirically in the real editor by measuring each container's rendered height vs. its content.
evals.label: wrong-use-case
evals.notes: Real incident AHA-283. The agent spent 8 rounds and its shipped fix touched ONLY the shared 16px empty .selected-fields wrapper, calling it done — while the dominant ~64px empty plugin settings iframe (__zoid__presenter_slide_plugin_iframe reported height:48px with an empty <body>, +16px .form-group margin) was left. Both confirmed live in the editor; Idea Board (native) shows the shared 16px but never mounts the iframe. The failure was incomplete differential diagnosis (fixing the first cause found, not the full measured height). Logged so the skill trains agents to account for every empty container and fix each at its own layer.

evals.prompt: Design the editor right-panel config (Content panel) for a new slide type, Split the Points — a point-allocation poll where each participant splits a shared budget across 2–8 labelled options. Presenter can set the total budget (default 100, range 10–1000), a step size, and the unit (points / dollars / percent), and choose a result chart. Lay out the whole panel.
evals.expected_output: Applies §10 (slide-type right-panel config) and diffs against the reference frames. Produces: Question (title textarea + alignment + optional image + Add description) → an option list using the 'Items' anatomy (drag handle since order-agnostic here is optional, text input with a neutral placeholder matching Poll — 'Option 1', 'Option 2' — a focus-only character counter, on-hover delete that DISABLES at the 2-item minimum, and NO image button since this type has no per-option images — omitted, not a disabled stub) with a '+ Add' button → participation/mechanic settings: a 'Total budget' numeric input capped in length (mirror Poll's 4-digit cap), numbers-only, clamped to 10–1000 with an immediate on-change/blur fallback, pre-filled with default 100; a 'Step size' numeric input with the same contract; a 'Measurement unit' select that pre-selects the recommended default and lists it first → a Time-limit toggle revealing its duration select (dependent sub-setting, hidden when off) → a collapsed Advanced section for show/hide-results and similar low-frequency toggles. Every ? help glyph is the same shared-component icon at the same size with consistent tooltip placement; setting names are noun phrases (mode toggles like 'Show results manually' are the allowed exception); grouping is spacing-driven with no dividers/cards. A placeholder is never rendered as real content downstream. Self-checks with aha-design-settings-judge and reaches OK TO SHIP.
evals.label: build-from-reference
evals.notes: Positive build eval derived from Split the Points (AHA-46123). Following §10 here prevents the real QA bugs that shipped on this slide type: AHA-46438 (explanation as hover-value not tooltip), AHA-46440 (numeric input with no limit/clamp/numbers-only/default), AHA-46484 (missing option placeholders + placeholder rendered as real), AHA-46489/AHA-46544 (inconsistent ? glyph/size), AHA-46508 (missing timing + show/hide-result sections), AHA-46562 (select default/order). The BAD-example counterparts live in the aha-design-settings-judge dataset.
